newsitem.title: USA: ServiceMaster to pay $626 mln for WMX stake.
newsitem.headline: ServiceMaster to pay $626 mln for WMX stake.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP has agreed to buy from WMX Technologies Inc its entire ownership interest in ServiceMaster for about $626 million in cash, the companies said Wednesday.

Oak Brook, Ill.-based WMX owns or has rights to acquire 29.035 million restricted shares of ServiceMaster, including an option to purchase 1.875 million shares which would be cancelled as part of the transaction, the companies said.
The transaction is expected to close on or before April 14, they said.

"The transaction is expected to be immediately additive to ServiceMaster earnings per share and will provide significant, incremental tax benefits to ServiceMaster. It also eliminates market uncertainties regarding the status of the WMX shares," said ServiceMaster chief executive Carlos Cantu.
Cantu said ServiceMaster intends to initially finance the repurchase with bank financing.

"The company is evaluating a number of long-term financing alternatives for both this transaction and its pending tender offer for Barefoot Inc, which is expected to expire on February 21," ServiceMaster said.
Cantu said Phillip Rooney, ousted Tuesday as chief executive of the embattled WMX, will continue to serve as a member of the ServiceMaster board of directors.

WMX chairman and acting chief executive Dean Buntrock said, "Although our investment in ServiceMaster has provided exceptional returns to our shareholders, WMX is returning to a highly-focused waste management services company and we believe our investments should be limited to core business activities. With this transaction, we are well along the way toward achieving our goal announced two weeks ago of monetizing an additional $1.5 billion of non-core assets."
ServiceMaster is a network of service companies active in numerous markets.
WMX, the largest U.S. garbage hauling company, is in the midst of a broad restructuring program intended to appease dissatisfied major shareholders and refocus the business.
